salary_details.pay_scale: Honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture, to the maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month

how_to_apply: Applications are made in two parts: an online form on the AMU Careers Portal (careers.amuonline.ac.in), followed by a signed hard copy sent by post. Applications on plain paper are not entertained.

Fill the Application Form only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal of the University, https://careers.amuonline.ac.in, by 28 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.). Follow the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual available on the portal.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- for each Application Form. The fee is paid only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal.
After successful submission, take the printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a front facing recent photograph at the designated place on the form.
Attach self attested copies of all relevant documents to the form (see the list below).
On the top-left side of the cover, write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date (Assistant Professor (Contractual), FM/46/2026, dated 19.11.2026).

Send the complete form by post to: Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002. The hard copy must reach by 5 December 2026. Hard copies will not be received after 05.12.2026 (04:00 p.m.).

The University will not be responsible for postal delay or for any late receipt or non-receipt of the Application Form. A separate Application Form is required for each post listed under a different serial number of the advertisement.
The Local Selection Committee for ELIGIBLE candidates will be held on 12 December 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh.
Candidates must report with all original documents in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, half an hour before the scheduled time of the Local Selection Committee.
No separate Notice or Interview letter will be issued to the candidates.
Candidates must bring 01 presentation on a topic from their area of interest in their subject, in soft copy (pen drive), for presentation at the time of interview.

The University may set up a committee to scrutinise the applications and shortlist applicants. It reserves the right to limit the number called for interview to a reasonable number based on its rules or criteria.
important_instructions: Only persons with a relevant disability of at least 40% may apply for posts earmarked for PwD candidates. They must upload a Disability Certificate issued by the Competent Authority on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I). Applicable categories: (A) Blindness and low vision (VH); (B) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH); (C) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); (D) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (E) Multiple disabilities from (A) to (D), including deaf-blindness. The Appendix-I Proforma is available on https://www.amu.ac.in, https://www.amuregistrar.com and https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. The Medical Board of the University will examine the disability claim of the selected applicant before the appointment letter is issued.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AMU Recruitment 2026 under advertisement FM/46/2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Assistant Professor (Contractual) in the Department of Oral Medicine & Radiology, Dr. Z.A. Dental College.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The online form must be submitted by 28 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.). The hard copy must reach by 5 December 2026 and will not be received after 04:00 p.m. that day.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for this post?
faq.answer: The qualification is "As per DCI norms, adopted by AMU." Eligibility is reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The post carries an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture, to the maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs. 500/- per Application Form, paid only online at the Careers Portal. PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. Then post the signed printout with your photograph and attested documents to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee is on 12 December 2026 at 12:30 p.m. in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. Candidates must report at 12:00 noon with all original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Will AMU send an interview letter?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no separate Notice or Interview letter will be issued to the candidates for this Local Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the originals of all documents enclosed with the application and 01 presentation on a topic from your area of interest in your subject, in soft copy on a pen drive.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on a purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.
